# Knowledge Compiler CLI

The Knowledge Compiler CLI provides a command line interface for managing the compilation of engineering artifacts into a knowledge base. It facilitates various operations such as initializing a repository, compiling changes, reconciling merged pull requests, and validating compliance with specific standards.
